question: Q2: necessity (change it, recount the exact outcome)
number: Length 64 is the layout 0^32 || x with x in m8..m15. Changing the length changes the layout (x must keep 32 bytes): blen = 4s + 32 gives 706 .. 595 ops (s = 0..8); a bare constant change of v14 (blen 1..64) leaves 595. So 64 is needed for the cheapest layout, not for the digest.
